## Flight Minutes 1.0

First release.

- Times every flight path you take and remembers how long each route lasts. It ships without any data: every time is measured on your own flights.
- From the second flight on a route, a small frame shows your destination and a countdown until you land.
- On a new route the frame shows the time flown so far, and after landing the measured time is printed in chat.
- Keeps an average of the last five flights per route. Alliance and Horde routes are stored apart.
- Drag the frame to move it, the position is saved.
- `/fm` or `/flightminutes` shows how many routes are known, `/fm list` lists them with their times, `/fm forget` clears all routes.

## Flight Minutes 1.1

- New: hover a destination on the flight map to see how long the flight from where you stand takes, for example "Flight time: 2:41".
- Destinations you can fly to but have not timed yet say "not timed yet".
- Works on both flight maps of the game.
- As in 1.0, the times are shared by all your characters of the same faction, so a new character sees them from the first visit.
- Your routes from 1.0 are kept and used as they are.

## Flight Minutes 1.2

- New **arrival sound**: Flight Minutes can play a short sound 10 seconds before the learned landing time, when you land, or both. It is off until you switch it on, so nothing changes unless you want it.
- `/fm sound before`, `/fm sound landing`, `/fm sound both` and `/fm sound off` set when it plays. `/fm sound` shows the setting.
- Pick the sound with `/fm sound bell`, `chime`, `horn`, `warning` or `whisper`. The new choice plays once so you can hear it.
- The early sound needs a timed route and does not play when you stop a flight early. Routes shorter than 20 seconds only get the landing sound.
- The sound plays on the Master channel, so you hear it even with sound effects muted.
- Your routes and the frame position from 1.1 are kept.

## Flight Minutes 1.3

- New **flight totals**: Flight Minutes adds up how many flights you took and how long you spent in the air, for this session and for all time on each character.
- `/fm stats` shows both totals, for example "This session: 3 flights, 7m 12s in the air."
- `/fm` now shows the totals under the number of known routes, and hovering the flight frame during a flight shows them too.
- `/fm stats reset` clears the all-time total of the character you are playing. Your routes and the session total stay.
- A session starts when you log in; a `/reload` keeps it going. Flights you stop early count for the totals, but still teach no route time.
- Your routes, sound choice and frame position from 1.2 are kept. The totals start at zero with this version.
